lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments on the mid-to-posterior torso terminate abruptly, creating a dashed pattern that does not span the full height of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of approximately 8-10 white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and the upper portion of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the upper-mid haunch align into a horizontal geometric row.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white chevron-like marking on the muzzle bridge and a distinct white patch on the ventral neck/throat region.
